title: No Saturation
description: This plugins makes it so when you switch worlds it removes your saturation not your hunger
body:
## 🧩 NoSat Plugin Description

NoSat is a lightweight Spigot/Paper plugin designed to automatically reset player saturation to zero whenever they change worlds. This helps maintain consistent hunger mechanics across multiple worlds, especially in survival or hardcore setups where balanced gameplay is important.

The plugin is configurable through the config.yml file, allowing server owners to enable or disable its functionality easily. It also includes a /nosatreload command (permission: nosat.reload) to reload the configuration without restarting the server.

### Features:

- Automatically sets player saturation to 0 when switching worlds

- Simple enable/disable toggle via configuration

- /nosatreload command to refresh config in real time

- Lightweight and optimized for performance

Perfect for servers that want to prevent saturation exploits or ensure uniform hunger behavior across different dimensions or pvp servers with arena.
